summary: City page read: 16 sites (1-8 full hookup 50-amp $30, 9-16 water/30-amp $25 along the river), tents $15; FCFS only; showers, flush toilets, free dump. All stored values confirmed (now manual). Not waterfront kept on imagery despite the city's 'along the Rock River'. Season not posted. Pin OK.
flags: Fees, hookups, facilities and FCFS booking all confirmed from the city page; provenance derived -> manual.

Waterfront: keep not waterfront (contrary claim checked). The city says sites 9-16 are 'along the Rock River', but the Rock River here is a stream about 10 m wide (creek-sized, so at most creekside), and imagery shows the RV pads on the west loop (~43.8712,-96.1414) 25-40 m from the water behind a continuous riparian tree band; one camper at ~43.87188,-96.14074 sits ~20 m from the bank among trees. No pad on open ground within ~50 m of the water. The park's fishing pond (~0.5 ha, ~43.8722,-96.1395) is east of the loops, away from the sites.
Pin 43.87057,-96.14052 is at the campground entrance off Mill Street, ~70-100 m south-east of the pads: OK.
Season: not posted on the city page; a web-search summary says Explore Minnesota lists summer and fall without dates (not read). Season left unset.
